description: Ships NO CODE. Declares and pins the Desert Ant Labs Ear LiteRT artifact set and serves on-device spoken language identification through the host's model-runtime lane: tool identify_language backed by the ear/mel-v1 processor.

tools.name: identify_language
tools.description: Identify the spoken language of an audio recording on device: the most likely language, its confidence, a reliability flag and the top candidates.

skills.name: identify-language
skills.description: Use identify_language to identify the spoken language of a user recording on device before routing, translating or tagging it.
